description: This file defines the CustomerActivity controller class for the OpenCart admin extension, responsible for handling customer activity reports, including displaying the report form, saving settings, and generating customer activity reports with filters and pagination.

classes.name: CustomerActivity
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer activity reports in the admin panel, with methods for displaying the report page, handling saving configurations, and retrieving report data with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, loads header, column, footer, and view for the customer activity report form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report configuration settings, checks user permission, updates settings via model, and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and outputs the customer activity report view with current report data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the customer activity report list data, typically for AJAX updates.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves filtered customer activity data, applies pagination, constructs report items, and returns the rendered report list view.
